description: Update Prompt defaults: weekly updates, minor and patch updates grouped, major updates separately, security fixes right away, GitHub Actions pinned by commit SHA

packageRules.description: One weekly PR with all minor and patch updates. Major updates keep their own PRs, because they can break things and need their own review.

Indirect Go modules too, in a weekly PR of their own. Renovate skips them by default, so a fix in a module like golang.org/x/net would wait until a direct dependency pulled it in. A separate group keeps a bad indirect bump from holding back the other updates.
No major updates of indirect Go modules: the direct dependencies decide those.

customManagers.description: Tool versions pinned in workflows and composite actions, marked with a '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' comment on the line above
